about: Golden prompt set for tool discovery (OpenAI Apps SDK, Optimize Metadata): direct = the user names EOR Scope, indirect = the user describes the outcome, negative = no EOR Scope tool should run (expected_tool "none"). Data for a future evaluation replayed in ChatGPT; test/golden.test.mjs only checks that every expected tool exists.
